description: Retrieve one InterPro or member-database entry with full metadata by default, except that an overlaps_with array of more than 20 records returns its first 20 with overlapsPage and the continuation call. Select optional sections while retaining core and unknown metadata; overlapLimit and overlapOffset page whole overlap records in upstream order, and offsets are not a snapshot across calls.

accession.description: InterPro or member-database entry accession, such as IPR011615 or PF00870; no URL syntax.

includeThumbnail.description: Include each Wikipedia thumbnail image, base64 data often hundreds of KB; defaults to false.

overlapLimit.description: Positive integer number of whole overlap records per page; values above 10,000 are clamped to 10,000 with a notice. Without it, pages hold 20 records, and when overlapOffset is also omitted an overlaps_with array of at most 20 records returns whole.

overlapOffset.description: Nonnegative safe integer offset of the first overlap record to return; defaults to zero. Pass overlapsPage.nextOffset to continue.

sections.description: Retain these named sections and all core or unknown metadata; omitted means full detail, and an empty array retains core metadata only.

sourceDatabase.description: Database slug; inferred from standard accession prefixes when omitted.

name: interpro_get_entry

entry.description: Upstream metadata after explicit section selection and overlap paging, with readable descriptionText when description is retained; raw description shapes and sparse annotations survive. Wikipedia thumbnails are omitted unless includeThumbnail is true.

descriptionText.description: Readable description text decoded from source HTML fragments; absent without textual content.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `overlaps_not_selected`: overlapLimit or overlapOffset is supplied but sections excludes overlaps_with. `database_mismatch`: Explicit database conflicts with accession routing. `accession_source_unknown`: Accession has no inferred or explicit database. `entry_not_found`: Entry detail returns 204 or 404, or the accession is a set accession. `entry_withdrawn`: Entry or set returns 410. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The shared fifty-second budget expires while the entry request is retried. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream JSON, structure, or continuation is incompatible. `upstream_response_too_large`: An upstream response exceeds 4 MiB. `upstream_rejected`: InterPro returns an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: InterPro has a network or server failure; HTTP 501 is not retryable. `upstream_timeout`: InterPro returns HTTP 408/504 or an attempt exceeds its deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: InterPro returns HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Section selection, overlap page continuation or availability, and omitted Wikipedia thumbnail guidance.

omittedSections.description: Named sections actually removed from upstream metadata.

overlapsPage.description: Overlap paging state, present when overlapLimit or overlapOffset is supplied or a default call pages an array of more than 20 records; unavailable arrays have no fabricated total.

oneOf.description: Page of complete upstream overlap records.

nextOffset.description: Next offset when more records remain.

oneOf.description: Overlap paging unavailable for a missing or null source section.

sections.description: Canonical selected sections, when explicitly selected.

totalCount.description: Total upstream overlap records when the reply pages an available array.

title: InterPro entry metadata
